policy: Manuscript writing and polishing use a contract-first workflow. Nature-style writing craft is adapted for English high-impact journal work and technical computational social-science manuscripts, and target-journal corpus signals can guide pre-submission style adaptation after readability review. Chinese journals, CSSCI writing, traditional quantitative work, and qualitative research keep the local social-science standard as the primary rule; no style layer can override facts, evidence, citations, results, or author decisions.

adopted_as: article architecture before sentence polishing
section-specific writing contracts for title, abstract, introduction, methods, results, discussion, and conclusion
logic-first polishing diagnosis
claim-evidence-boundary calibration
reader-flow and paragraph-control checks
Chinese-to-English rebuild before English polish
not_adopted: bulk installing the nature-* skill bundle
Nature/CNS house style as the default social-science journal target
biomedical, materials, image-experiment, or wet-lab standards as default gates
PubMed or MeSH as default discovery priority
English-language style rules overriding Chinese journal conventions

adopted_as: long-form writing intake with project facts and asset inventory
chapter plan before chapter prose
decisions log for user confirmations and assumptions
figure, table, formula, code, data, and reference manifests
placeholder protocol for figures, tables, equations, symbols, and references
template-preserving DOCX workflow as explicit opt-in pattern
not_adopted: auto-triggering a thesis studio for ordinary paper writing
bundled Word templates as local defaults
Word XML script runtime as the default docx export path
manual reference numbering that bypasses citation verification
example data, example figures, or simulated results without explicit user permission

adopted_as: format-sensitive Chinese-English rewriting for LaTeX versus Word
back-translation or logic-flow check after bilingual rewriting
micro shorten and expand operations with explicit delta logs
minimal-change Chinese and English polishing thresholds
AI-style surface cleanup without changing claims
logic redline check that reports only blocking issues
data-bound experiment or result analysis paragraphs
plain academic figure and table title generation
reviewer-perspective final audit with fatal-versus-fixable distinction
conference or journal venue migration checklist as a submission-package adapter
not_adopted: copying the prompt bundle verbatim as local runtime instructions
OpenSkills installation as a local stack management path
current model ranking or provider preference as environment policy
CS or LLM conference assumptions as default social-science manuscript structure
arXiv translator runtime as a default local paper-writing tool
letting a prompt template bypass citation verification, figure gates, or package freeze checks

adopted_as: claim-preserving academic humanization as a surface audit
Chinese academic de-template scan for mechanical connectives, inflated novelty, and low-density phrases
English academic humanizer checks for vague attribution, excessive hedging, causal overclaiming, and generic conclusions
second-pass audit after polishing
detector-evasion boundary: improve authorial academic prose without promising to bypass detection
detect-first then rewrite-second academic humanization workflow
Chinese five-step de-template loop: locate, classify, rewrite, self-check, second-pass review
English severity audit for vague attribution, inflated novelty, causal overclaiming, formulaic transitions, generic conclusions, and rhythm uniformity
locked-items ledger before any surface rewrite
not_adopted: bulk installing external humanizer, deslop, stop-slop, avoid-ai-writing, or Chinese de-AIGC skills as competing runtime routes
treating AIGC score reduction as more important than academic integrity
changing claims, evidence, citations, variables, model results, or uncertainty for surface style
copying detector-specific tactics as local policy
using an external humanizer skill to bypass local writing quality, citation, or peer-review gates
optimizing manuscripts for a detector score instead of writing quality and evidence integrity
adding fake human imperfection, typos, colloquial looseness, or unsupported stylistic noise

adopted_as: humanities thesis intake before drafting
research object, problem, thesis direction, theory, type, and length confirmation
theory-as-tool and material-as-destination writing rule
close-reading and material-first chapter opening discipline
chapter progression and transition paragraph checks
quote-followed-by-analysis requirement
humanities literature review grouped by argument function
terminology consistency and bilingual glossary check
footnote function and format checks
not_adopted: bulk installing the upstream humanities-thesis skill
using upstream search.py as a replacement for local literature acquisition, CNKI, Google Scholar, Zotero, or citation-verifier chains
copying long terminology or theorist tables as verified references
treating title, abstract, or metadata-only search results as sufficient paper content evidence
Claude Code or OpenClaw platform instructions as local Codex runtime policy

adopted_as: target-journal corpus as a dynamic style evidence layer for pre-submission polishing
priority order: manuscript facts and claims, user instructions, target-journal corpus, secondary corpus or exemplars, then static base rules
5-8 readable target-journal papers as the preferred primary style corpus when available
conversion and readability gate before any style extraction
paper style cards and aggregated journal style profile before revision
section-by-section diagnosis, journal-fit score, revision log, and conflict log
temporary dynamic writing skill as a project artifact rather than a global runtime skill
not_adopted: installing journal-adapt as a competing top-level runtime skill
using unread, partial, or failed PDF conversions as style evidence
copying, quoting, or paraphrasing target-journal corpus prose into the user manuscript
letting journal style override manuscript facts, evidence, citations, results, equations, variables, or author decisions
treating target-journal style evidence as DOI verification or citation evidence
auto-installing the upstream recommended external static writing skills

adoption_options.label: Directly install upstream nature-writing and nature-polishing
adoption_options.description: Installing the upstream skills would duplicate local routing and import English STEM assumptions as runtime defaults.
strengths: keeps upstream wording close to its source
risks: duplicates local writing and evidence workflows
may treat English high-impact journal prose as universal
may make STEM paper sections the default for humanities and social-science work

adoption_options.label: Adapt writing craft into a local manuscript contract
adoption_options.description: Add a local schema, catalog, validator, route entry, and skill that distinguish language target and discipline target before drafting or polishing.
strengths: keeps research-autopilot as the single route
makes English/Chinese and STEM/social-science differences explicit
turns polishing into a checkable workflow instead of loose prompt advice
lets citation capture and evidence verification remain mandatory when references are touched
risks: requires validators and routing to stay synchronized
adds one more source contract that must be maintained

adoption_options.label: Keep Nature style only as an optional English preset
adoption_options.description: Use the upstream rules only when the user explicitly asks for Nature-style English polishing.
strengths: low risk for Chinese journal work
risks: underuses useful article-architecture and logic-diagnosis rules
does not improve default writing quality for computational social-science manuscripts

adoption_options.label: Leave writing under citation capture only
adoption_options.description: Keep using writing-reference-capture as the main writing surface.
risks: mixes reference capture with manuscript craft
cannot express language and discipline differences
keeps polishing rules scattered across prose documents

language_targets.label: 中文人文社科或 CSSCI 写作
language_targets.default_posture: Local Chinese social-science writing rules are primary; Nature-style English rhythm is not imported as default.
style_rules: 先确认目标是中文期刊、中文学位论文、中文报告还是中文投稿修改稿
保留中文学术写作的概念密度、问题意识、文献脉络和理论定位
涉及数据分析的段落继续遵守 PEEL 闭环
句子可以比英文更长，但每段必须只有一个控制性论点
不得用英文期刊的短句节奏机械改写中文段落
reject_when: 用户要求英文期刊投稿润色
目标期刊明确要求英文高影响期刊结构和表达
项目目标是英文摘要、英文 cover letter 或英文 response letter

language_targets.label: 英文高影响期刊写作
language_targets.default_posture: Nature-style craft can be used aggressively for structure, section moves, sentence economy, and reader-flow control.
style_rules: 先把核心主张、证据、边界和 novelty 限定写清楚，再做语言润色
摘要写成 compact mini-paper，不堆背景
引言按 context -> problem -> gap -> approach -> key finding -> contribution 收束
结果段只报告证据和必要解释，讨论段再处理意义、机制和边界
英文句子优先 10 到 30 词，避免多重从句和空泛强调
reject_when: 用户明确要求中文期刊风格
目标是中文 CSSCI 或中文学位论文正文
英语只是内部翻译草稿且尚无明确投稿目标

language_targets.label: 中英转换和双语过渡
language_targets.default_posture: Do not translate sentence by sentence. Rebuild the argument map first, then write in the target language.
style_rules: 先把中文主张、证据、变量、方法、边界拆成 claim-evidence-boundary 表
英文稿按目标期刊读者重组段落，不逐句硬译
中文回译或双语摘要要保持概念一致，不为了流畅改变主张强度
关键术语必须建立中英对照表
reject_when: 没有原文、目标语言或输出用途
用户要求只做参考文献核验或 PDF 下载

discipline_targets.label: 人文社科默认标准
discipline_targets.primary_standard: Local social-science logic controls the manuscript: research question, theory, literature gap, data/materials, method or interpretation, evidence, boundary, ethics, and citation integrity.
do_not_import: method-module claims without a real method contribution
Nature/CNS novelty language when the paper targets a Chinese or field-specific journal

discipline_targets.label: 计算社会科学或方法技术型论文
discipline_targets.primary_standard: Local social-science standards remain primary, but technical clarity, pipeline description, data processing transparency, robustness, and reproducibility can borrow more from STEM writing craft.
do_not_import: claiming algorithmic novelty without benchmark or ablation evidence
using technical detail to hide weak theory
dropping measurement validity, ethics, or platform boundary

discipline_targets.label: 传统量化研究
discipline_targets.primary_standard: Use local journal conventions for theory, hypothesis, data, variable construction, identification or model choice, robustness, heterogeneity, and boundary statements.
do_not_import: turning ordinary regression results into discovery-claim language
treating p values as the whole evidence chain
forcing STEM figure-panel logic where tables or coefficient plots are clearer

discipline_targets.label: 质性或解释性研究
discipline_targets.primary_standard: Use local qualitative logic: case selection, material boundary, coding or interpretation procedure, thick evidence, alternative interpretation, and reflexive limitation.
adapted_from_nature: evidence hierarchy across excerpts, cases, and interpretation
do_not_import: removing necessary contextual explanation for the sake of English brevity

workflow_modes.label: 起草论文段落或章节
required_steps: declare language and discipline target
select section contract
build claim-evidence-boundary map
draft by section moves
run writing-quality checks

workflow_modes.label: 重构段落、章节或论文主线
required_steps: diagnose structural failure before editing
separate background, claim, evidence, explanation, and boundary
reorder paragraphs by reader-flow
only polish sentences after argument repair

workflow_modes.label: 润色中文或英文论文语言
required_steps: declare whether the request is Chinese, English, or bilingual
diagnose whether the issue is logic, evidence, paragraph flow, terminology, or sentence style
avoid changing claims, evidence, citations, and results without explicit marking
return revision notes with risk flags
outputs: risk flags for claims or citations

workflow_modes.label: 中英互译并重建学术表达
required_steps: extract argument map before translation
preserve claim strength and evidence boundary
reconstruct in target-language academic convention
report terminology decisions

workflow_modes.label: 区分 LaTeX 和 Word 的中英转换
required_steps: declare whether output targets LaTeX, Word, plain text, or DOCX
preserve LaTeX commands and escape LaTeX special characters only for LaTeX output
strip or avoid Markdown syntax for Word/plain-text output
rebuild the argument in the target language instead of sentence-by-sentence polishing when needed
return a back-translation or logic-flow note when it helps verify meaning

workflow_modes.label: 微幅缩写、扩写或轻改
required_steps: state whether the request is micro-edit, rewrite, or structural repair
preserve all facts, variables, results, citations, and uncertainty markers
keep the delta small unless the user explicitly asks for structural rewriting
produce a modification log that names what was compressed, expanded, or left unchanged

workflow_modes.label: 去除机器化表达但不改主张
required_steps: scan for empty rhetoric, mechanical transitions, overused AI phrases, translationese, and needless parallelism
change only wording, rhythm, and paragraph flow unless the user authorizes argument repair
keep technical terms, claims, evidence, citations, and uncertainty unchanged
if the text is already natural and rigorous, return it unchanged with a pass note
choose detect-only or rewrite mode before editing
write a locked-items ledger for facts, data, citations, variables, estimates, uncertainty, limitations, quotations, and author-defined terms
run Chinese five-step surface audit when the target is Chinese academic prose
run English severity audit for vague attribution, inflated novelty, causal overclaiming, formulaic transitions, generic conclusions, and rhythm uniformity when the target is English academic prose
preserve legitimate academic phrases when they carry real logical or evidentiary work
run a second-pass audit after revision and report any remaining surface risks
state explicitly that no detector-bypass guarantee is made

workflow_modes.label: 换会议、改投或投稿格式迁移
required_steps: lock the source manuscript and preserve a rollback copy
map target venue requirements for length, anonymization, structure, checklist, ethics, data, code, figures, tables, and supplementary materials
migrate content without inventing results, citations, analyses, author details, or reviewer claims
separate mechanical template changes from substantive writing changes
run citation, writing, figure-table, peer-review, reproducibility, and package-freeze checks before calling it ready

workflow_modes.label: 目标期刊适配润色
required_steps: lock manuscript facts, claims, results, citations, equations, variables, and author-defined terms as the highest priority
record user instructions and intended submission destination before style extraction
use 5-8 fully readable target-journal papers as primary style evidence when available
reject unreadable, partial, failed, or metadata-only corpus files from style extraction
extract paper style cards that describe only structure, rhetorical moves, section order, voice, tense, and register
aggregate a journal style profile with recurring patterns, conflict table, red flags, and human review notes
use secondary field papers and user or lab exemplars only as lower-priority support when target-journal evidence is thin
revise one section at a time with diagnosis, journal-fit score, applied rules, preserved items, and conflict log
send changed citation claims, figure/table wording, data statements, or result interpretations back to the corresponding local gates
outputs: revision log with preserved-item and conflict records

workflow_modes.label: 定稿前写作质量检查
required_steps: run writing_quality_rules checks
confirm citation capture when references are touched
confirm figure/table text consistency when figures are touched
list blockers separately from optional improvements
decide whether target-journal adaptation is needed before final surface polishing
if a journal style profile is used, confirm it came only from readable corpus files and did not change claims or evidence

workflow_modes.label: 人文社科论文选题和主线澄清
required_steps: ask for missing object, problem, thesis direction, theory, paper type, and expected length before drafting
classify the failure mode as object-without-question, question-without-argument, theory-without-material, scattered-notes, or draft-repair
build a provisional thesis sentence that is arguable, demonstrable, and directional
map theory concepts to specific material evidence instead of starting from abstract theory
route missing literature or citation evidence to evidence-based-literature-workflow

section_contracts.label: 标题
section_contracts.section_job: Make the object, mechanism or relation, scope, and contribution searchable without overclaiming.
move_order: name the empirical or theoretical object
avoid slogan, metaphor, or unsupported causal promise
section_contracts.social_science_adaptation: 中文标题可保留概念密度；英文标题优先可检索、短而具体。计算社科标题可以点出方法，但不能让方法掩盖问题。

section_contracts.label: 摘要
section_contracts.section_job: Summarize the problem, gap, material or method, core finding, contribution, and boundary as a mini-paper.
section_contracts.social_science_adaptation: 中文摘要可更强调理论问题和研究对象；英文摘要更强调 compact sequence。不得把未核验引用、未完成分析或过度政策含义写进摘要。

section_contracts.label: 引言
section_contracts.section_job: Lead the reader from field-level importance to the exact research gap and the paper's answer.
section_contracts.social_science_adaptation: 中文社科引言通常更重视问题意识、理论脉络和现实语境；英文高影响期刊引言更重视快速收束。传统量化和质性研究不得把方法技术写成唯一贡献。
quality_checks: gap is not merely topic absence
reader can predict the paper's evidence path

section_contracts.label: 文献综述
section_contracts.section_job: Organize prior work by theoretical problem, mechanism, method, or empirical debate rather than listing papers.
move_order: group literature by problem or mechanism
section_contracts.social_science_adaptation: 中文综述可更完整交代理论谱系；英文综述应更快服务 gap。所有正式引用仍由 evidence-based-literature-workflow 和 writing-reference-capture 接管。

section_contracts.label: 方法、数据或材料
section_contracts.section_job: Explain what evidence is used, why it can answer the question, and what it cannot support.
section_contracts.social_science_adaptation: 计算社科和方法论文可以借鉴模块化 pipeline；传统量化研究优先解释变量、模型和识别；质性研究优先解释材料、案例选择、编码和解释程序。

section_contracts.label: 结果
section_contracts.section_job: Report findings in the order that supports the argument, without drifting into broad discussion.
section_contracts.social_science_adaptation: 传统量化结果优先主模型、机制/异质性和稳健性；计算社科结果还要解释指标、误差和模型比较；质性结果应以材料片段和解释链支撑主张。

section_contracts.label: 讨论
section_contracts.section_job: Explain what the evidence changes in theory, empirical understanding, method, or practice, while naming boundaries.
section_contracts.social_science_adaptation: 中文论文可更充分展开理论意义；英文高影响期刊要避免重复结果。没有证据支持时，只能写可能解释或研究启示。

section_contracts.label: 结论
section_contracts.section_job: Close the paper by restating the bounded answer, contribution, and remaining uncertainty.
section_contracts.social_science_adaptation: 中文结论可以适度写现实启示，但不得把启示写成未被证实的政策处方；英文结论保持短而具体。

section_contracts.label: 人文社科论文章节
section_contracts.section_job: Advance one argumentative step from material evidence to interpretation, then hand a remaining tension to the next chapter.
move_order: start from a material detail, previous chapter tension, or specific unresolved question
analyze quotations, cases, archive items, field materials, or textual details
connect the analysis to the theory concept only after the material is visible
close by naming what this chapter proves and what remains to be explained
section_contracts.social_science_adaptation: 人文社科章节不能只是平行材料陈列，也不能先铺大段理论背景再找材料套进去。理论是工具，材料是落点；历史背景只能提供语境，不能替代解释。
quality_checks: research object, question, and thesis direction are visible
theory concept lands on specific material
chapter ending creates a real transition

polishing_levels.label: 论证修复
polishing_levels.purpose: Fix broken logic before sentence-level polish.
actions: identify missing claim, evidence, explanation, or link
downgrade unsupported causal or novelty claims
mark missing evidence or citation blockers

polishing_levels.label: 段落流动
polishing_levels.purpose: Make paragraphs readable while preserving the argument.
actions: make each paragraph carry one controlling idea
move background before claim only when needed
place evidence next to the claim it supports
add transitions that name logic, not decoration
blockers: multiple unrelated claims in one paragraph

polishing_levels.label: 句子和术语
polishing_levels.purpose: Improve precision, density, and readability after logic passes.
actions: shorten English sentences when they exceed the reader's working memory
keep Chinese clauses dense but not overloaded
blockers: language fluency deletes uncertainty or boundary

polishing_levels.label: 投稿表层检查
polishing_levels.purpose: Check the final surface after evidence, citations, figures, and section logic pass.
actions: check title, abstract, keywords, captions, and headings together
confirm citations touched by editing go back to writing-reference-capture
confirm figure/table wording matches final evidence
list remaining blockers before optional style preferences
check whether the target journal style profile or target requirement is available when the user requests journal-specific polishing
separate target-journal style improvements from citation, figure, data, and result changes
blockers: figure or table wording no longer matches its source
target journal or language requirement is unknown
journal-specific polish requested but no target journal, corpus, style profile, or user-approved fallback is available
target-journal style suggestion would alter facts, evidence, results, equations, variables, citations, or author intent

default_outputs: remaining citation, evidence, or author-input blockers

safety_rules.rule: Never invent data, sample size, results, references, DOI, journal status, or source quotations during writing or polishing.
safety_rules.failure_action: Stop and route the missing item to evidence-based-literature-workflow, citation-verifier, reference-fulltext-acquisition, or user input.

safety_rules.rule: Nature-style English journal writing is a selectable craft preset, not the default for Chinese journals, CSSCI work, or all social-science manuscripts.
safety_rules.failure_action: Re-declare the target language and discipline, then rerun the section contract.

safety_rules.rule: STEM method-module or wet-lab conventions cannot override humanities and social-science theory, evidence, interpretation, ethics, and citation rules.
safety_rules.failure_action: Switch to the proper discipline target and explain which upstream pattern was rejected.

safety_rules.rule: If the paragraph lacks a claim, evidence, explanation, or boundary, the system must repair or report the logic issue before sentence polishing.
safety_rules.failure_action: Return a blocking logic diagnosis instead of a polished but misleading text.

safety_rules.rule: When polishing adds, removes, reorders, or changes citation-bearing claims, writing-reference-capture and citation evidence rules remain mandatory.
safety_rules.failure_action: Send the changed citation claims to writing-reference-capture before final delivery.

safety_rules.rule: Chinese thesis-style DOCX manifest, placeholder, and template-writeback workflows are explicit opt-in patterns; do not auto-trigger them for ordinary manuscript drafting, journal polishing, or simple Word export.
safety_rules.failure_action: Stay in manuscript-writing-studio or research-docx-export unless the user explicitly asks for a thesis-studio workflow.

safety_rules.rule: External prompt templates can provide wording and workflow patterns, but they must not override local citation verification, figure/table gates, social-science writing standards, or submission-package freeze checks.
safety_rules.failure_action: Treat the prompt as an adapter pattern only, then rerun the local manuscript, evidence, figure, or package contract.

safety_rules.rule: Humanities and interpretive social-science writing must not force a fashionable theory onto materials before a concrete research object, problem, and material tension are visible.
safety_rules.failure_action: Return to the humanities thesis intake, restate the material evidence, and rebuild the theory-material fit note.

safety_rules.rule: A paper's argument, evidence, quotation, or limitation cannot be analyzed from title, abstract, keyword, citation count, or search-result metadata alone.
safety_rules.failure_action: Mark the source as candidate-only or metadata-only, then route full-text acquisition or structured reading before using it in the manuscript.

safety_rules.rule: Target-journal style extraction can use only fully readable full-text corpus files; title, abstract, metadata, partial OCR, failed conversion, or search-result snippets cannot support a journal style profile.
safety_rules.failure_action: Mark the corpus item as excluded or candidate-only, then ask for readable text, replace the paper, or proceed with an explicit user-approved fallback.

safety_rules.rule: Target-journal style evidence may change framing, order, emphasis, transitions, and register, but must not alter manuscript facts, evidence, citations, results, equations, variables, figures, tables, or author decisions.
safety_rules.failure_action: Stop the revision, report the conflict, and route the affected claim, citation, result, or figure/table wording to the proper local gate before continuing.

safety_rules.rule: AIGC, detector, or similarity numbers cannot become the manuscript objective. The local target is rigorous, authorial, evidence-faithful academic prose that preserves facts, data, citations, variables, estimates, uncertainty, limitations, and author intent.
safety_rules.failure_action: Reframe the request as academic writing-quality cleanup and report detector-related concerns only as non-guaranteed external signals.

safety_rules.rule: Do not add typos, colloquial fillers, false uncertainty, decorative synonyms, emotional noise, or artificial imperfection to make academic prose appear human.
safety_rules.failure_action: Remove the noise and return to claim-preserving academic surface cleanup.
